title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.1.7.363
body_markdown:
### Fixed

* IdeaVim: Don't disable Copilot completion when IdeaVim is turned off using the status bar.
* IdeaVim: Only show suggestions when IdeaVim is in insert or replace mode.
* IdeaVim: Hide Copilot suggestions after ESC was pressed to leave insert mode of IdeaVim.
body_html:
Fixed

  • IdeaVim: Don't disable Copilot completion when IdeaVim is turned off using the status bar.
  • IdeaVim: Only show suggestions when IdeaVim is in insert or replace mode.
  • IdeaVim: Hide Copilot suggestions after ESC was pressed to leave insert mode of IdeaVim.
